qa.answer.description: Answer the current question using all parent evidence artifacts.
qa.answer.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

qa.expand_query.description: Generate the next-hop query using current question and intermediate evidence; carry all input evidence documents forward.
qa.expand_query.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

qa.extract_facts.description: Extract supported facts while retaining source passage IDs.
qa.extract_facts.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

qa.merge_evidence.description: Union and deduplicate all parent evidence by source ID.
qa.merge_evidence.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

qa.query_plan.description: Plan an initial evidence query from the current question; initialize carried documents to an empty list.
qa.query_plan.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

qa.rerank.description: Rank passages for the declared evidence intent.
qa.rerank.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

qa.retrieve.description: Retrieve real passages using the declared strategy; merge carried documents with new passages and retain provenance.
qa.retrieve.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

qa.rewrite_query.description: Rewrite a query for a declared complementary evidence intent; preserve carried documents.
qa.rewrite_query.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

qa.select_answer.description: Compare all candidate answers and their retained evidence.
qa.select_answer.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

qa.summarize.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

qa.verify_evidence.description: Check whether evidence supports the current question's constraints.
qa.verify_evidence.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.classify.description: Classify query complexity and annotate generation context.
sql.classify.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.decompose.description: Decompose the question into relational requirements.
sql.decompose.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.execute.description: Execute candidate SQL read-only with timeout; return execution diagnostics, never gold comparisons.
sql.execute.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.generate.description: Generate one candidate SQL using every parent context.
sql.generate.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.join_analysis.description: Resolve join paths, keys and cardinality constraints.
sql.join_analysis.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.merge_context.description: Merge all parent schema annotations, preserving disagreements.
sql.merge_context.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.prune_schema.description: Annotate selected schema elements for a relational concern; retain immutable base schema and join keys rather than destructively removing them.
sql.prune_schema.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.repair.description: Revise SQL from current question, schema and observed execution diagnostics.
sql.repair.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.retrieve_values.description: Read database values for grounding without modifying the database.
sql.retrieve_values.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.schema_linking.description: Link the current question to a fixed database schema and evidence.
sql.schema_linking.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.select_and_correct.description: Compare all candidates, then review the selected SQL; fused terminal selection.
sql.select_and_correct.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.select_candidate.description: Compare candidate SQL and available diagnostics without reference SQL.
sql.select_candidate.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

sql.self_correct.description: Review and correct the selected SQL against the current task and schema.
sql.self_correct.side_effects: none; resource access must be read-only

basic_multihop.title: DSPy BasicMultiHop / SimplifiedBaleen
basic_multihop.use: Query generation, retrieval, answer stages; generated branches are our extensions.

din_sql.title: DIN-SQL
din_sql.use: Schema linking, classification/decomposition, generation, self-correction stages; execution-guided repair is our extension.
